cohort: A 28-year-old primipara with multiple risk factors who developed Necrotizing Fasciitis (NF) following a scheduled cesarean delivery.
finding: Prompt recognition, early surgical intervention, and targeted antibiotic therapy were crucial for successful treatment of Necrotizing Fasciitis in this high-risk obstetric patient.
mod_finding: Necrotizing Fasciitis developed following a scheduled cesarean delivery in this high-risk patient, emphasizing the importance of vigilance in postoperative patients.
